description: Letta agent team for AppForge. Each agent is a persistent Letta agent with its own memory that learns across projects.

pm.name: AppForge-PM
pm.role: Product Manager — turns raw ideas into structured product specs

architect.name: AppForge-Architect
architect.role: System Architect — produces tech stack, routes, API endpoints, data models

database.name: AppForge-Database
database.role: Database engineer — generates PostgreSQL schemas and seed data

backend.name: AppForge-Backend
backend.role: Backend engineer — generates Next.js API routes with auth and validation

frontend.name: AppForge-Frontend
frontend.role: Frontend engineer — generates React pages with Tailwind and shadcn/ui

testing.name: AppForge-Testing
testing.role: QA engineer — reviews code and produces test results

compliance.name: AppForge-Compliance
compliance.role: Compliance auditor — checks GDPR, CCPA, COPPA, HIPAA, WCAG, PCI-DSS

devops.name: AppForge-DevOps
devops.role: DevOps engineer — generates deployment configs and CI/CD

orchestrator.name: Tutor
orchestrator.role: Orchestrator — coordinates the agent team, manages the pipeline
